messages:
deploy-bot: rollout started: v2.14.0 -> canary-usw2. Running post-deploy smoke: synth probes, kvprobe, healthchecks. dashboard https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/2765432101 :rocket:
maria: early flag: small number of synth failures on /chat-stream (trace ids attached). p95 elevated ~300ms -> 1.2s at 2765432120. :frowning:
tom: can you paste a sample?
maria: ```
[2765432118] synth /chat-stream -> 200 latency=320ms trace=tx-1f2a
[2765432119] synth /chat-stream -> 200 latency=1180ms trace=tx-1f2b
[2765432120] synth /chat-stream -> 500 upstream_timeout trace=tx-1f2c
```
ravi: infra-alerts shows slight uptick in kernel fallback rate coincident with rollout. also kvcache miss rate for chat-prefixes spiked briefly.
qa-bot: automated regression check failed: embed-density test case #42 flaked (0.9% failure). marking for triage.
maria: given this, recommend reducing canary traffic for chat routes to 1% and continue monitoring. no full rollback yet.
tom: agree. run routing tweak to send 99% of /chat-stream to v2.13.4, 1% to v2.14.0. command: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /chat-stream --versions v2.13.4:99,v2.14.0:1 --reason "smoke: chat p95 spike"```
maria: applied at 2765432135. deploy-bot: routing change recorded (audit id r-audit-9001).
deploy-bot: notice: canary still serving v2.14.0 for other routes.
ravi: collecting heap profiles and kernel-selection logs. linking traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-1f2a https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-1f2b https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-1f2c
qa-bot: scheduled 10m recheck for synth + kvprobe. will post summary.
maria: update: after pinning majority traffic back, p95 for /chat-stream back near baseline (~140ms) within ~40s. no further 500s observed.
tom: let's avoid immediate rollback. open follow-up ticket RINF-4521: "v2.14 chat route tail latency regression". include traces, kvcache heatmap, and candidate repro steps. assign to serving-ops and infra.
ravi: pinged @serving-ops and @infra-team. will try to reproduce with a controlled load matching canary sample.
maria: action items: maria monitor 15m, ravi gather kernel diffs and repro attempts, tom update release notes with temporary partial pin and ticket link, qa-bot to rerun failing case nightly. If regression reappears or affects >5% of routes escalate to full rollback.
qa-bot: 10m check: all clear so far. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
